Uses of Package
hadur2.core.world

Packages that use hadur2.core.world
Package
Description
hadur2.core
Hadur 2's core: the whole of the robot's strategy, as plain Java that never sees the Robocode engine.
hadur2.core.melee
Melee (free-for-all) subsystems: opponent tracking, sweep radar, minimum-risk movement, target selection, circular targeting and posture strategy, and each opponent's melee profile block (MMEM-1), driven each tick by MeleeController.
hadur2.core.world
 
  • Classes in hadur2.core.world used by hadur2.core
    Class
    Description
    EnemyInfo
    Latest known state of one opponent in the current round.
    EnemyShot
    A shot an opponent fired, inferred from an energy drop the core could not explain as damage (MSENSE-2): who fired, from where, when, and at what power.
    EnemyTracker
    Per-round model of the battlefield: every opponent Hadur has scanned, its last position, heading, velocity, energy and scan tick, whether it is alive, and the shots its energy drops show (MSENSE-2).
    Roster
    The World's teammates and its count of enemies alive (A5): who is on our team, where each was last known to be and since when, who is known or presumed dead, and from the enemies' deaths a count that never falls below the truth (WORLD-3, WORLD-8).
    Roster.Mate
    One teammate as the World knows it.
